evidence: Prospective bounded refinement protocol; original v1 acceptance criteria unchanged
split: EN01 and JA01/JA02 development; EN02/EN03 and JA03–JA06 held out. No claim of new model-pretraining independence.
baseline: Reproduce all twelve archived outputs before adapter changes; compare units and line estimates exactly.

pronunciation.JA02: Preserve dropped long-vowel source support in an explicit fixed range. Compare unchanged phone sequence and an explicit repeated-vowel alternative; no reference times used.
pronunciation.JA06: Nonstandard small-kana sequences: compare literal full-size kana expansion with common palatalized approximations. These are linguistic hypotheses, not human-verified sung readings. No automatic best-reference selection.
pronunciation.positive_control: Identity reading override on one accepted Japanese case; repeat estimates.

endpoint.scope: All English line endpoints; onsets frozen. Whole-mixture RMS is not vocal activity.
candidates: Nearest sustained low-energy run within a bounded local window, with fixed energy/window parameters chosen on EN01 only
Unchanged estimate plus review-required flag when silence evidence is absent or end touches recording boundary
endpoint.censoring: EN02 final endpoint remains excluded from accuracy aggregation; never interpret clip boundary as silence evidence.

types: replace with independently authored absent phrase
omit final phrase while retaining original audio
negative_controls.development: EN01 and JA01; matched positives and deliberate negatives both enter diagnostic threshold selection
negative_controls.held_out: EN02/EN03 and JA03, thresholds frozen before held-out score inspection
negative_controls.scores: TIFA token agreement and CTC forced-token log support; uncalibrated. Report false acceptance/rejection and model-unresolved outputs separately.

promotion: No endpoint correction or confidence threshold enters active preparation unless held-out evidence supports it. Pronunciation overrides remain explicit supplied data with unchanged display source.
limits: Reuse local assets; no new downloads; cumulative 2-GB download / 6-GB storage ceilings.
